Good afternoon, and welcome to the Grand Park Hotel. This is Anna, from the front desk. Here are three things for your first night. First, the restaurant is on the first floor, and you can have dinner from seven to eleven. You can't pay with cash in the restaurant, only with a card. Second, the swimming pool is on the roof. It is open until nine, and you can get a towel there. Third, the gym is next to the elevator, and you can use it all night with your key. If you need anything, you can call me. Just press zero. Have a good evening.

I travel a lot, and my English is not perfect. But I can do a lot of things. I can check in at a hotel, I can ask for the Wi-Fi password, and I can order food in a restaurant. I can understand people when they speak slowly. But I can't understand fast English on the phone, and I can't watch a movie without subtitles. Not yet. Last week I asked a receptionist: can you speak slowly, please? And she said: of course I can. That is my favorite sentence now. Can you speak slowly, please? It works everywhere.
Good evening. Can I ask you something? Can I use the pool now? Sorry, you can't. But you can use the gym. And what is the Wi-Fi password? It is on your key card. Have a good night!
